options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: mode
options.description:
Which mode you are playing on.
Practice Mode: You need to unlock the stage in order to progress.
Normal Mode: The resources are only given at Stage 1. Restriction in life or difficulty for stages 3/4 and 5/6 and character are the only logical gate

options.name: stage_unlock
options.description:
[Practice] How the stage unlock are grouped in Practice mode and for the Extra Stage if it's apart
Global: No group
By Character: Stage group by character
By Shot Type: Stage group by shot type. Need check by shot type or check by difficulty in order to have enough locations. Stages will be unlocked by character if there is not enought location.

options.name: progressive_stage
options.description: [Practice] In Practice mode, determine if stages are unlocked progressively

options.name: exclude_lunatic
options.description: Exclude Lunatic difficulty. Start on Hard instead.

options.name: number_life_mid
options.display_name: Number of life expected in order to face Nitori and Aya
options.description: Number of life the randomizer expect you to have before facing Nitori and Aya

options.name: difficulty_mid
options.display_name: Difficulty in order to face Nitori and Aya
options.description: The difficulty expected in order to face Nitori and Aya (Starting from Lunatic and go to Easy)

options.name: number_life_end
options.display_name: Number of life expected in order to face Sanae and Kanako
options.description: Number of life the randomizer expect you to have before facing Sanae and Kanako

options.name: difficulty_end
options.display_name: Difficulty in order to face Sanae and Kanako
options.description: The difficulty expected in order to face Sanae and Kanako (Starting from Lunatic and go to Easy)

options.name: extra_stage
options.display_name: Determine if the extra stage is included
options.description:
Determine if the extra stage is included
Linear: The extra stage is considered as the 7th stage.
Apart: The extra stage has it's own item for it to be unlocked
This option will follow the rule of how the stage are unlocked in Practice Mode (Global, By Character or By Shot Type)

options.name: number_life_extra
options.display_name: Number of life expected in order to face Suwako
options.description: Number of life the randomizer expect you to have before facing Suwako

options.name: shot_type
options.description: If each shot type have their own check and are not just separated by character

options.name: difficulty_check
options.description: If checks are separated by difficulty.

options.name: check_multiple_difficulty
options.description: For difficulty check, choose if the check of the highest difficulty include the check of the lower difficulties that are unlocked. Can be changed later.

options.name: goal
options.description: If the Extra stage is included, determine which boss is the goal.

options.name: ending_required
options.display_name: How many time do you need to beat the required boss
options.description: How many time do you need to beat the required boss if it's the selected goal.

options.name: ring_link
options.description: Whether your in-level Power Point gain/loss is linked to other players. Can be changed later.

options.name: limit_lives
options.description: Limit on the maximum number of lives you can have. It only apply on the client, not on the item pool or logic. Can be changed later.

options.name: traps
options.display_name: Percentage of fillers that are traps
options.description: Percentage of fillers that are traps

options.name: power_point_trap
options.description:
Weight of the -50% power point trap.
This trap reduce the power point by 50%

options.name: life_trap
options.description:
Weight of the -1 life trap.
This trap remove 1 life

options.name: reverse_movement_trap
options.description:
Weight of the Reverse Movement trap.
This trap reverse the movement of the player

options.name: aya_speed_trap
options.description:
Weight of the Aya speed trap.
This trap make the speed of the player more extreme (faster normally, slower focus)

options.name: freeze_trap
options.description:
Weight of the freeze trap.
This trap freeze the player for a short amount of time

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: exclude_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: priority_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: item_links
options.description: Share part of your item pool with other players.

options.name: plando_items
options.description: Generic items plando.
